checks.name: Updater failures, locks, concurrency and migration
checks.expected: Previous verified installation retained; no duplicate transfer
checks.playtest: Playtest: Updater failures, locks, concurrency and migration
checks.observed: Verified immutable update under lock; corrupt/partial/malformed fallback; cancellation; two concurrent processes downloaded once; legacy migration reused bytes.

checks.name: Native executable and two-version bootstrap update
checks.expected: Empty PATH works; active shell retained; new shell activates next start
checks.playtest: Playtest: Native executable and two-version bootstrap update
checks.observed: Two packaged fixture generations: bundled runtime launched verified v1; bootstrap staged v2 while v1 active; next start executed v2. No public release claim.

checks.name: Failed shell activation rollback
checks.expected: Failed downloaded shell returns to acknowledged downloaded shell, not bundled shell
checks.observed: Executable shell exited 7 without acknowledgement; downloaded working shell resumed, installed pointer rolled back, rejected artifact not restaged, immutable JARs retained.
